events.summary: After the Supreme Verdict, the Chamber is built in Gateway Plaza on the ashes of Jace's former sanctum, and Jace tells Lavinia the site 'seemed fitting'.

During the War of the Spark Bolas orders Tezzeret to activate the Planar Bridge atop the Chamber, stripping Jace of his Guildpact power and wrecking the embassy with Ajani, Chandra, Jaya and Karn inside.
events.quote: the Chamber was catastrophically damaged when Nicol Bolas ordered Tezzeret to activate the Planar Bridge atop it

events.summary: Nissa Revane leads a ritual at the ruined Chamber, restoring leylines and resurrecting Niv-Mizzet as the new Living Guildpact.
events.quote: resurrecting Niv-Mizzet as the new Living Guildpact

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion the compleated Vraska orders the Chamber breached and desecrated.
events.quote: Under her orders, the Chamber of the Guildpact was breached and desecrated

events.summary: Ral Zarek stands atop the ruins of the Chamber and uses a device to disrupt Vraska's compleation, wounding her and scattering her swarm.
events.quote: critically wounding her and scattering her swarm

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet continues to reside in the Chamber under reconstruction, restoring only his chair.
events.quote: leaving the Guildpact's chair as the only component of the chamber to have been fully repaired
